submitted.rationale: EQE rises steeply toward the Fe-rich side: 0.006% at Sb 0.51 (near FeSbO4), 0.35% at 0.27, and 1.47% at Sb 0.199. This is most likely an Fe2O3-rich mixture with some Sb added. Index 2 is the best of the compositions measured. The optimum may lie at an even lower Sb fraction (indices 0–1), but no EQE budget was left to check.
